notes.title: The Jukebox Update 04/08/24
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Can now toggle between songs in the cafe by clicking on the jukebox.
[*] Added a visual indication to Ace's Vanishing Act and Statue's Re-Energize
[*] Wait For It reworked: "Deals 10 damage. Energy reduced by 1 each time it's discarded without use." -> "Deals 22 damage. Energy reduced by 1 each time it's discarded. Burn."
[*] Turn The Tables description updated: "Deal 9 damage to each enemy planning to attack next turn." -> "Deal 9 damage to each enemy planning to attack."
[*] Updated Ace's lore and pronouns
[*] Koko will no longer ask you for your credit card information.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug when playing Photobomb with Leave It To Me in your hand.
[*] Koko will no longer softlock your game if you skip her dialogue.
[*] Fixed several card description bugs.
[*] The journal no longer shows updated values for cards that change during gameplay.
[*] Damage block now properly prevents damage from Balloon Animal
[/list]

notes.title: Street Shuffle is out on Steam now!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who's been supporting us on our journey. To anyone who hasn't had a chance to playtest our game, there's plenty to explore! 

[list]
[*] Face off against other performances to win over the favor of the crowd using a unique card drafting mechanic
[*] Build your deck as you level up Ace and all your friends
[*] Visit several vibrant locations of Dunkopolis
[*] Jam out to our original soundtrack that will have you moving your body along to the beat while your team pulls off their best moves
[/list]

Once you play, let us know what you think! We always love to hear feedback from players to know how we can improve the game! And if you enjoy it, please leave us a review on Steam! It's a big help to letting Street Shuffle reach more people!

We'll be on discount until the end of March so make sure to check it out soon!
